title: token-level-observability-metrics-tracing-dashboards-alert-tuning
author: Ethan Lee
description: Motivation: reduce alert noise while providing engineers per-route, per-token cost and latency visibility and stronger trace correlation for tokenized workloads. This PR implements token-level metrics emission, tracing hooks for token attribution, new Grafana dashboards for token cost/latency breakdowns, and tuned alert rules to cut false positives during short-lived spikes. Changes are backwards-compatible at the API surface: metrics are optional and gated by a new observability config flag. Rollout plan: feature-flag rollout for internal customers, enable for 10% of traffic for 48 hours, sweep logs/metrics for regressions, then gradual ramp. Includes test coverage and CI runs. See linked Linear items for eval prompt sets and alert thresholds used in tuning.
commits: feat(observability): emit token_level.latency and token_level.cost metrics per-route (token_dimensions)
feat(tracing): add token attribution span tags and link token_id to request trace when enabled
chore(dashboards): add grafana dashboard token_cost_latency.json and templates for per-model per-route views
fix(alerts): tune token-latency alert thresholds and add suppression window for transient spikes
test(observability): add unit and integration tests for token metric aggregation and retention
review_comments: Priya Natarajan: Overall looks good. Can you explain the suppression window choice for the token-latency alert?
Ethan Lee: The suppression window is 5m by default to let transient batching spikes pass; tuned based on 7-day spike analysis. Can be overridden per-customer.
Luis Gomez: Please add a migration note for on-prem customers to the private-installer docs.
Ethan Lee: Added docs/observability/token-level.md and a brief note in private-installer README in a follow-up commit.
Aisha Khan: Unit tests look solid. Can we add an integration test that simulates KV-cache warmup tail latencies?
Ethan Lee: Added integration test that replays synthetic KV-cache warmup traces and asserts alerts are not fired for transient tails.
release_notes: Add token-level cost and latency dashboards; emit token_level metrics and tracing tags; tune token-latency alerts to reduce false positives; feature-flag controlled; no breaking changes.
